why: Post-snapshot papers report the Overfull Conjecture confirmed for maximum degree 4 graphs, for robust expanders/large graphs with max degree at least (1+eps) times half their order, and improved bounds (Dec 2025), all restricting the general open conjecture; the full conjecture itself remains unproved.
